answer: A practical sybil defense is staked admission: every agent entering the harbor of the agent economy must lock a refundable bond before it can whisper a single vote. An attacker multiplying wallets multiplies cost, since each clone needs fresh collateral, while honest agents eventually reclaim their stake. Peer attestation then works like surveyors crossing a tundra: reviewers only certify identities whose on-chain behavior over past epochs looks human-spent and varied, so cloned agents that act in lockstep fail review and forfeit their bonds to the treasury.
